text: Use the fact card. What animal group is the cat in?
The cat is a mammal.
Now look at a frog instead of a cat. Is it a mammal? Make a sentence starting with The frog.
The frog is not a mammal.
Use the card to find and fix one wrong group word.
Frogs are amphibians.
Use the fact card. What group is the elephant in? Say a full sentence.
The elephant is a mammal.
Use the fact card. Is the frog a mammal? Say a full sentence.
The frog is not a mammal.
Use the fact card. What group are the orangutans in? Say a full sentence.
The orangutans are mammals.
Use the fact card. What covers the birds?
Birds have feathers.
Now describe one lizard instead of the birds. Use the card for its body covering.
This lizard has scales.
Use the card to fix one body-covering word.
The cat has fur.
Use the card. What covers the bird? Say a full sentence.
The bird has feathers.
Use the card. What covers the two cats? Say a full sentence.
The cats have fur.
Use the card. What covers the lizard? Say a full sentence.
The lizard has scales.
Use the card. Tell the body part and its number for birds.
Birds have two wings.
Now think about orangutans instead of birds. Do they have wings? Make a full sentence.
Orangutans do not have wings.
Use the card to fix one body-part word.
The bird has two wings.
Use the card. What does the bird have? Include the number.
The bird has two wings.
Use the card. Do orangutans have wings? Answer with a full sentence.
Orangutans do not have wings.
Use the card. Do these birds have wings? Say a full sentence.
These birds have wings.
Use the card. What do chickens lay? Say what they do.
Chickens lay eggs.
Now talk about cats instead of chickens. Correct the egg claim using the card.
Cats do not lay eggs.
Use the card. Fix one word about what chickens lay.
Chickens lay eggs.
Use the card. What do chickens lay? Say a full sentence.
Chickens lay eggs.
Use the card. Do cats lay eggs? Say a full sentence.
Cats do not lay eggs.
Use the card. What do these birds lay? Say a full sentence.
These birds lay eggs.
Use the fact card. What do gills help fish do?
Gills help fish breathe.
The old claim says only fish have gills. Use the crab fact to add another animal. End with too.
Crabs have gills too.
Use the card to fix one action word.
Gills help fish breathe.
Use the fact card. What do gills help fish do? Say a full sentence.
Gills help fish breathe.
Use the two facts. Do only fish have gills? Name another animal in a full sentence.
Crabs have gills too.
Use the fact card. What helps these baby frogs breathe? Say a full sentence.
These baby frogs use gills to breathe.
Use the fact card. Where can this frog live?
This frog can live in water.
The frog can live in water. The new card adds another place. Where else can it live? End with too.
This frog can live on land too.
Use the fact card. Find and fix the small word before the place.
The frog can live on land.
Use the card. Where can this frog live? Say a full sentence.
This frog can live in water.
The first place was water. Use the new card to say where else this frog can live.
This frog can live on land too.
Use the card. Where can this frog live? Say a full sentence.
This frog can live on land.
